title: A Counterexample to Nivat's Conjecture for a Non-Convex Window of Full Affine Span
summary: We construct an exact cluster $F\subseteq\mathbb{Z}^2$ of cardinality $8$ with full affine span, together with an $F$-tiling $T$, such that the orbit closure of $T$ in $\{0,1\}^{\mathbb{Z}^2}$ does not contain a $1$-periodic $F$-tiling. Since every $F$-tiling is a low-complexity configuration with respect to the window $\bar F := \{-a : a \in F\}$, this supplies a "non-degenerate" counterexample, in a strong sense, to Nivat's conjecture for non-convex windows.
